title: Intern - Mechanical Engineer
description:
Human Computer Lab is a robotics startup and research lab building expressive robots that feel alive and responsive. Our first robot, LeLamp, explores a new category of consumer robotics where everyday objects become interactive and help us reshape our attachment to technology.

Our goal is to push the frontier of human-robot interaction by making technology more legible, emotionally intuitive, and human-centered. We are building the foundation for a new generation of robots designed for everyday environments.

What to expect

In this role, you will be responsible for building the robotics hardware systems that power robot expression, communication, and behavior. You will work closely with ML/software engineers to develop expressive companions, build real-time robotics systems, and integrate robotic hardware with machine learning — turning research and simulation into reliable, production-ready robots.

In this role, you will:

  • Develop robotic hardware that physically expresses perception, intelligence, and behavior

  • Build robotic hardware that supports tasks such as computer vision, audio processing, and interaction understanding

  • Integrate ML systems with robotic hardware and embedded systems

  • Improve robot perception, responsiveness, and expression

  • Collaborate with ML/software engineers to build expressive robotics systems

You may be a good fit if you:

  • Are pursuing a degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field

  • Have experience designing robotics hardware and electronics

  • Have experience in prototyping and building with microcontrollers, embedded systems, and PCBs

  • Have strong CAD skills using tools such as Onshape, SolidWorks, Fusion360, or similar, as well as proficiency in 3D printing

  • Have experience with human computer interaction as it relates to robots, especially robots in the home

  • Are comfortable jumping into unfamiliar systems and can create order through chaos.

  • Care about users and feel ownership over outcomes, even for systems you don't own.

  • Think holistically about systems and approach complex problems with creative, outside-the-box solutions.

You will be a strong fit, if you:

  • Are passionate about building and experimenting with hardware

  • Move quickly and work well in rapid iteration cycles.

  • Take ownership over the systems they design and build.

  • Are curious, resourceful, and motivated to solve difficult problems.

  • Work well in small, collaborative teams.

  • Consider not just what immediately works, but how consumers will engage with robots.


The early team becomes the DNA of the company. We set ourselves and others to a high standard, and we respond with kindness when things get hard but keep everyone accountable. This requires us to be curious, creative, and diverse in our thinking and approach.

We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. Even if you don’t meet every single requirement, we encourage you to apply. Studies show that women and underrepresented groups often hold back unless they meet 100% of the criteria - we don’t want that to be the reason we miss out on great talent.

title: Creative Project Manager
description:
The Role

As a Creative Project Manager, you will be the operational backbone of the creative function at our agency. You’ll partner closely with creative strategists, designers, media teams, and contractors to ensure work is scoped correctly, resourced effectively, and delivered on time — without sacrificing creative quality or performance outcomes.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in fast-moving agency environments and can balance structure with flexibility as scopes evolve at the pace of AI-driven change.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

Project & Scope Management

• Track and manage project scope across hours, deliverables, and timelines to ensure work aligns with client agreements and internal capacity

• Scope new creative initiatives and iterations, with flexibility to adjust scopes as priorities, performance insights, or AI-driven workflows evolve

• Partner with strategy and account teams to identify scope risks early and recommend solutions

  • Partner with sales and account teams during the scoping phase to validate deliverables against team capacity before contracts are finalized (scope approval from this role is required before client agreements are signed)

  • Flag scope threshold breaches at 75% usage and escalate immediately to service lead and account manager for client notification and billing decisions

  • Track and report absorbed overage costs monthly to quantify revenue impact and inform contract negotiations

Workflow & Resourcing

• Manage day-to-day workflow and allocation of creative strategy and design team resources

• Monitor team utilization across accounts and proactively flag resourcing gaps or bandwidth constraints

• Coordinate timelines and deliverables across internal teams and external contractors

  • Escalate capacity conflicts to leadership with clear tradeoff recommendations when competing client priorities exceed available resources (e.g., "Client A timeline slips 3 days OR Client B gets reduced execution quality")

  • Make day-to-day resource allocation decisions within approved capacity; escalate strategic prioritization decisions that require client relationship or revenue considerations

Process & Tools

• Own and maintain creative workflows in Asana, ensuring projects, tasks, dependencies, and timelines are clearly documented and up to date

• Lead recurring creative standups to review work in progress, upcoming priorities, potential challenges, and risk areas

• Identify and implement process improvements to support speed, clarity, and scalability

Collaboration & Communication

• Serve as the central point of coordination between creative, media, strategy, and contractor teams

• Ensure teams have clear briefs, expectations, and timelines before work begins

• Communicate status updates, changes, and risks clearly to stakeholders

  • Flag scope threshold breaches (at 75% usage) and escalate to the service lead and account manager for client notification and billing decisions

  • Escalate capacity conflicts to leadership with proposed tradeoffs when competing priorities exceed available resources

  • Partner with account managers to notify clients of scope departures, timeline impacts, or need for additional budget

Authority and Decision Rights

This role has authority to:

  • Approve or reject project timelines based on team capacity

  • Allocate resources across accounts within budgeted hours

  • Pause work when critical brief information is missing

  • Require brief revisions before creative work begins

This role escalates to leadership:

  • Scope changes that exceed contracted deliverables

  • Capacity conflicts requiring client deprioritization

  • Contract-level decisions on billing overages vs. absorbing costs

  • Strategic tradeoffs between client relationships and team sustainability

title: Quality Control Analyst (HPLC)

AT&R aims to provide world leading consultancy services across highly regulated industries.

Independent Assurance - We provide risk based, proportionate, independent oversight and assurance of whether a project, process, system or product meets defined standards, requirements, or expectations.

Research & Technology - We identify, define and execute programmes of Research and Technology to support the continued safe operation of some of the world’s most complex engineering challenges, including the UK Naval Nuclear Propulsion Programme.​

With aspiration to grow, transform and evolve into new industries, locations and technologies.

Our dynamic, customer facing Independent Nuclear Assurance (INA) team has been supporting the Ministry of Defence’s (MoD) naval nuclear propulsion programme for over sixty years. A number of exciting opportunities have arisen to join this diverse team of highly experienced staff who provide a key role in supporting the safe operation of the UK’s submarine fleet.

  • Working according to the best applicable safety, technical and regulatory standards against agreed programmes and budgets.

  • Working in accordance with business requirements for health, safety, environment, and security, as well as seeking continuous improvements in all aspects of work.

  • Degree (Level 6, minimum requirement) in science or engineering (or equivalent).

  • Membership of (or working towards) a professional institution is desirable.

  • Knowledge or operational experience of the Naval Reactor Plant is desirable.

  • Knowledge of safety cases (structures and function).

  • Familiarity with related documentation (NRPA NSMAs, DSA02-DNSR, ONR SAPs etc).

title: ASSISTANT DESIGN ENGINEER 1
description:
The NYC Department of Environmental Protection (DEP) enriches the environment and protects public health for all New Yorkers by providing 1.1 billion gallons of high-quality drinking water, managing wastewater and storm water, and reducing air, noise, and hazardous materials pollution. DEP is the largest combined municipal water and wastewater utility in the country, with nearly 6,000 employees. DEP's water supply system is comprised of 19 reservoirs and 3 controlled lakes throughout the system’s 2,000 square mile watershed that extends 125 miles north and west of the City.

The Bureau of Engineering Design & Construction (BEDC) currently has a portfolio of capital projects valued at $35B, and another $13.6B projected over the next 10-year commitment plan. The projects BEDC implements allows DEP as a whole to continue to operate and maintain an exemplary water supply system.

Our In-House Design (IHD) directorate provides design and engineering services to meet operations’ needs in a manner consistent with BEDC’s core values of safety, schedule, quality, and customer service. IHD supports projects from the capital project initiation process through preliminary design, design, procurement construction, and finally with the turnover to operations. IHD’s Design Services division includes Architectural, Site Civil, Structural, Process Mechanical/HVAC, Water Tunnel Mechanical Systems, and Electrical discipline sections. Each design section prepares design and construction documents including engineering plans and specifications for the construction of water supply, sewer, and wastewater treatment infrastructure. IHD projects are typically of the highest priority for the Agency. IHD’s Engineering Services includes the Quality Assurance, Laboratory Services, Specifications/Standard Operating Procedures, Sustainability, and BIM/CADD sections. The Engineering Services division focuses on project’s sustainability, resiliency, laboratory material testing, quality reviews and inspections, standardization of documents, project delivery standards and uses current BIM/CADD technology to streamline engineering design processes.

IHD’s Civil Section creates sustainable site and civil engineering designs for capital improvement projects that, in conjunction with other engineering disciplines, develop and shape DEP’s public infrastructure. The Civil Section is responsible for the preparation of civil engineering documents involving the construction, remodeling, operation, maintenance and repair of public infrastructure, including plans and technical specifications for large and complex projects for water supply, wastewater and miscellaneous facilities. Specific work areas include, but are not necessarily limited to, preparation of plans and specifications for site development work during and post construction including site grading and paving, yard piping, drainage and stormwater management, erosion and sedimentation control, and maintenance and protection of traffic. The Civil Section also continuously coordinates with other disciplines including Land Surveying, Geotechnical, Structural, Mechanical, Architectural, and Electrical throughout the entire design process. The Section also provides engineering design services during construction.

BEDC seeks to hire an Assistant Civil Engineer (Assistant Design Engineer 1) for IHD’s Civil Section, located at our headquarters in Queens, NY. Under supervision of the Lead Design Engineer, the selected candidate will assist in the implementation of capital projects through the design and construction phase by preparing engineering documents including drawings, calculations, and specifications for large, complex projects for water supply and wastewater facilities. Tasks may include preparing said engineering documents; conducting investigations and field visits; reviewing shop drawings and requests for information; preparing and completing change order documentation; assisting in project schedule development; communicating and coordinating with other engineers and stakeholders; and documenting issues/resolutions in issues logs.

1. Experience in the planning, layout and details of contract drawings, specifications, shop drawing review, field inspections and investigations.

2. Advanced computer software skills in using Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel & PowerPoint).

3. Experience in the design of site plans, piping plans, grading and drainage plans, and stormwater management for facilities during and post construction.

4. Experience in the application of code requirements, preparation of technical reports, and related design software applications.

5. Preference will be given to candidates with experience in AutoCAD (Autodesk) and Civil 3D.

6. Preference will be given to candidates who have passed the Fundamentals of Engineering (FE) exam.

7. Demonstrated skills in written and verbal communication.

8. A Motor Vehicle Driver’s License valid in the state of New York may be required for some assignments.

title: Commissioning and Installation Engineer
description:
About CRA Energy

CRA Energy is a Noida-based manufacturer of custom-engineered process and combustion equipment, including flare systems, thermal oxidizers, biogas compression and upgrading systems, gas processing skids, burners, H₂S scrubbers, and other environmental process packages. Every project is engineered-to-order and executed from design through commissioning for customers across India and international markets.

Purpose of the Role

The Commissioning & Installation Engineer / Technician is responsible for the successful installation, mechanical completion, commissioning, and handover of H₂S Scrubber Systems and associated process equipment at customer sites. The role ensures that every installation is executed safely, on schedule, and in accordance with engineering specifications while delivering the guaranteed H₂S removal performance.

This position serves as the technical lead during site execution, coordinating with project engineers, contractors, vendors, and customers to ensure seamless commissioning and successful project completion.

Key Responsibilities

1. Installation & Site Supervision

  • Supervise the installation of H₂S scrubber columns, ducting, recirculation pumps, piping, chemical dosing systems, and associated process equipment.
  • Ensure installation complies with approved engineering drawings, P&IDs, GA drawings, and OEM specifications.
  • Coordinate with rigging teams, crane operators, contractors, and site personnel for safe lifting, positioning, and anchoring of heavy equipment.
  • Verify equipment alignment, leveling, and mechanical integrity before commissioning.
  • Coordinate with civil, electrical, and instrumentation teams to ensure timely project execution.
  • Monitor installation quality and resolve site execution issues in coordination with the engineering team.

2. Testing & Commissioning

  • Perform pre-commissioning inspections and mechanical completion activities.
  • Conduct hydrostatic, leak, and pressure testing of piping and process equipment.
  • Verify alignment and operational readiness of pumps, blowers, fans, and rotating equipment.
  • Calibrate and commission field instruments including:
    • H₂S Gas Analysers
    • pH Meters
    • ORP Meters
    • Conductivity Meters
    • Flow Meters
    • Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs)
  • Supervise loading of packing media and charging of scrubbing chemicals.
  • Perform static and dynamic loop checks.
  • Execute dry commissioning and wet commissioning trials.
  • Validate airflow, pressure drop, and H₂S removal efficiency to meet project guarantees (typically 95–99% removal efficiency).
  • Troubleshoot commissioning issues and optimize system performance before customer handover.

3. Health, Safety & Environment (HSE)

  • Enforce strict H₂S safety procedures and site safety regulations throughout installation and commissioning.
  • Ensure mandatory use of PPE, portable gas detectors, and emergency response equipment.
  • Conduct Job Safety Analysis (JSA), Toolbox Talks, and risk assessments before commencement of work.
  • Ensure safe handling, storage, and disposal of chemicals in accordance with statutory and environmental regulations.
  • Promote a zero-incident safety culture at all project sites.

4. Documentation & Handover

  • Prepare Mechanical Completion Certificates, Pre-Commissioning Checklists, Commissioning Reports, Punch Lists, and Site Progress Reports.
  • Maintain complete commissioning documentation and testing records.
  • Conduct operator training covering system operation, routine maintenance, chemical dosing, troubleshooting, and safety procedures.
  • Support final customer acceptance testing and project handover.
  • Provide post-commissioning technical support where required.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Zero Lost Time Injuries (LTI) during installation and commissioning.
  • Completion of installation and commissioning within the planned project schedule.
  • Achievement of guaranteed H₂S removal efficiency (≥95%) under design operating conditions.
  • Successful mechanical completion with minimum punch-list items.
  • Timely submission of commissioning documentation and handover reports.
  • High customer satisfaction during commissioning and project close-out.


Requirements

Must Have

  • 3–8 years of experience in installation, commissioning, startup, or maintenance of industrial process equipment.
  • Experience with H₂S Scrubbers, Biogas Upgrading Systems, Chemical Scrubbers, Biological Scrubbers, Gas Treatment Systems, Air Pollution Control Equipment, or similar process plants.
  • Strong understanding of mechanical installation, piping systems, pumps, blowers, and rotating equipment.
  • Ability to read and interpret P&IDs, GA drawings, Isometric Drawings, and engineering documents.
  • Hands-on experience with field instrumentation calibration and commissioning.
  • Knowledge of corrosion-resistant materials including FRP, PP, HDPE, and Stainless Steel.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Willingness to travel extensively to project sites across India and overseas.

Good to Have

  • Experience in biogas, wastewater treatment, renewable energy, chemical process plants, or environmental engineering projects.
  • Familiarity with PLC-based control systems and SCADA interfaces.
  • Experience in chemical dosing systems and water treatment processes.
  • Exposure to FAT, SAT, and performance guarantee testing.
  • Knowledge of international safety standards and commissioning practices.
  • Basic understanding of electrical and instrumentation systems during commissioning.

This role offers an opportunity to work on advanced gas treatment and biogas upgrading projects, contributing directly to the successful delivery of engineered environmental solutions for clients in India and across global markets.






Benefits

  • Every project is custom-engineered — technically interesting work with real problem-solving, not catalogue order-taking.
  • Growing international footprint across biogas, oil & gas, and defence sectors.
  • Lean, ownership-driven culture — high autonomy, direct access to leadership, and visible impact.

title: Senior AI Engineer – (Land Services)
description:
The Senior AI Engineer will design, develop and deploy AI-enabled solutions to support WSP’s Land Services business, working from India as part of a multidisciplinary team supporting UK and Ireland projects. The role will focus on translating real land, property, GIS, data management and project delivery challenges into practical AI solutions that improve efficiency, quality, decision-making and client outcomes.

The role is suited to experienced professionals with hands-on capability in AI/ML engineering, Generative AI, Azure cloud environments, data engineering and solution delivery. The Consultant will take ownership of defined AI work packages, build fit-for-purpose solutions, support adoption by project teams and provide technical guidance to junior team members where required.

The position involves close collaboration with WSP’s Land experts, Transformation and Digital Insights / Data & Decision Science teams, project managers, GIS specialists and wider consultancy teams to identify opportunities, prototype solutions, deliver scalable outputs and embed AI into day-to-day project delivery in a controlled and responsible manner.

This role will support WSP Land’s digital transformation by rapidly turning ideas into practical AI solutions that can be embedded into everyday project delivery and enhance the services delivered to clients.

AI Solution Design & Development

  • Design, develop, test and deploy AI/ML and Generative AI solutions that address real business and project delivery challenges within Land and Property.
  • Build solutions using Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Agentic AI frameworks and relevant AI development tools.
  • Translate business problems into technical solution designs, including data flows, prompts, model selection, integration approach, success measures and deployment considerations.
  • Develop prototypes and production-ready tools that support automation, data analysis, document processing, reporting, project controls, land referencing and stakeholder engagement workflows.
  • Apply machine learning, natural language processing and LLM techniques to structured and unstructured datasets, including documents, registers, trackers, spatial data and project records.

AI, Data & GIS Integration

  • Integrate AI solutions with enterprise systems, APIs, databases, cloud services and existing business workflows, ensuring outputs are practical and usable by project teams.
  • Work with land, property, GIS, mapping and infrastructure datasets to identify patterns, automate repetitive processes and improve the quality and speed of project outputs.
  • Develop and maintain robust data pipelines and reusable components, templates, prompt libraries, code libraries and delivery frameworks for AI-enabled solutions.
  • Support data validation, model evaluation, version control, monitoring and continuous improvement of AI solutions deployed into operational use.
  • Ensure AI outputs are traceable, explainable where appropriate and aligned with agreed quality, security, privacy and governance requirements.

Stakeholder, Project & Business Support

  • Collaborate with Land experts across WSP UK, Ireland and India to identify opportunities where AI can enhance project delivery, improve efficiency or create new client value.
  • Engage with technical and non-technical stakeholders to understand requirements, explain solution options, manage expectations and support adoption of AI-enabled ways of working.
  • Identify business opportunities and translate operational challenges into scalable AI solutions that deliver measurable benefits for project teams and clients.
  • Prepare demos, technical notes, user guidance, knowledge-sharing materials and progress updates to support internal stakeholders and project teams.
  • Support business development activities, including contributing technical content for bids, proposals and innovation-led client discussions.
  • Maintain awareness of emerging AI tools, market trends, responsible AI practices and relevant standards, bringing practical insights back into the team. Mentor team on lessons learned and best practices. Drive innovation.

Delivery, Coordination and Team Support

  • Manage small to medium AI work packages with limited supervision, meeting agreed cost, quality, programme and governance requirements.
  • Coordinate with bid managers, project managers, digital specialists, GIS/data teams and senior stakeholders to prioritise requirements and manage delivery dependencies.
  • Provide day-to-day technical guidance to junior members of the team, including reviewing outputs and supporting skills development where required.
  • Support progress reporting, risk tracking, benefits tracking and internal coordination for assigned AI initiatives.
  • Contribute to improving templates, workflows, quality controls and knowledge repositories to build repeatable AI delivery capability within the team.

Overall

  • Organise and manage work in a professional and responsible manner, collaborating closely across multidisciplinary teams and supporting the Team Leader, Line Manager and Project Manager to complete tasks to WSP’s expected standards.
  • Maintain clear and regular communication with colleagues in India, the UK and Ireland on technical, project and day-to-day delivery matters; attend and contribute to team and project meetings.
  • Work within agreed project constraints, including time, budget, security, governance and quality requirements.
  • Take ownership of assigned tasks and proactively research solutions where required.
  • Support the development and training of colleagues in India to grow AI, digital and data capability within the Land and Property team.
  • Support Team Leader / Line Manager in resource planning, utilisation, team performance and development requirements where applicable.
  • Contribute to knowledge sharing in internal and external forums.
  • Ensure that Health & Safety, information security, privacy and responsible AI considerations are embedded into all work practices in line with company policies.
  • Undertake any other task assigned by the HoD / Team Leader / Line Manager.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Software Engineering or related discipline.
  • Relevant postgraduate qualification, professional certification or demonstrable specialist experience in AI, data science, cloud engineering, software engineering or geospatial analytics would be advantageous.

Mandatory Skills & Experience

  • 7+ years’ experience designing, developing and deploying AI/ML solutions in enterprise or project delivery environments; experience in infrastructure, consultancy, land/property, GIS, Geography or engineering environments would be highly valuable.
  • Hands-on experience developing and deploying AI solutions in Microsoft Azure environments.
  • Experience using Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search and related cloud AI services.
  • Strong understanding of machine learning algorithms, natural language processing techniques, model evaluation and AI solution lifecycle management.
  • Experience integrating AI solutions with enterprise systems, APIs, databases, data pipelines and cloud services.
  • Practical understanding of MLOps, version control, monitoring, governance and deployment of AI solutions into production or controlled operational environments.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, work with limited supervision and provide technical guidance to others.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder engagement and client relationship skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving capability, commercial awareness and passion for innovation in AI technologies.

Knowledge Preferred (Desirable)

  • Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102).
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Developer Associate (AZ-204) or Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305).
  • Databricks Generative AI Certification or equivalent AI / data engineering certification.
  • Strong programming skills in Python, including experience with frameworks such as LangChain, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, LangGraph or similar.
  • Experience with GIS platforms and spatial data tools such as ArcGIS, QGIS, FME or similar.
  • Experience applying AI and machine learning techniques to geospatial, land, property, mapping, infrastructure or project delivery datasets.
  • Experience working with Generative AI, large language models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Agentic AI and prompt engineering for real-world business problems.

Introduction to Demandbase:

Our offices are located in San Francisco, New York, Austin, Seattle, India, and the United Kingdom.

About the Role

AI Runtime Services owns the shared runtime that AI at Demandbase runs on — two ways. First, it's the layer that enables and supports the AI features in the Demandbase platform: product teams ship LLM features on top of it without reinventing model access, spend control, safety, and observability. Second, the team builds and supports internal AI solutions — the tooling and services the company uses to work with LLMs day to day. The pillars underneath both: the LLM gateway, cost controls, observability, evals infra, caching, and guardrails.

The surface is broad and the team is early. You won't be handed a narrow slice: expect to move across the gateway one week and the ingest pipeline the next — and across product-facing runtime and internal tooling — and to own what you build in production.

What you'll own

  • The LLM gateway. The single front door to every model provider we use — keys, routing, rate limits, failover, provider quotas. When it's down, every AI feature at Demandbase is down.

  • Reliability, for real. SLOs, on-call, incident response, and the postmortems for the runtime. This is a genuine SRE ownership role, not "build it and let someone else run it."

  • Cost control. Per-team and per-model attribution, budgets, quotas. LLM spend is the kind of line item that quietly triples; your job is to make it legible and then make it smaller.

  • LLM observability. Traces, spans, prompt/response capture, ingest and billing visibility for every AI feature in the company.

  • Evals and experimentation infra. The shared harnesses, datasets, and scoring plumbing product teams use to know whether a prompt or model change actually made things better.

  • Caching and guardrails. Response and semantic caching to cut latency and redundant spend; input/output safety, PII handling, and policy enforcement at the gateway.

What we need

  • Strong production infrastructure background: Kubernetes, AWS, Terraform, GitOps. You've operated systems that people were paged for, and you've been the one paged.

  • Python, at a level where you're comfortable owning services and tooling in it — not just scripting.

  • Real on-call and incident-response experience. You can talk about an incident you ran, what you got wrong, and what you changed afterward.

  • Observability fluency beyond "we have dashboards": you've instrumented systems, chased cardinality and cost in a metrics/logging backend, and built alerts that fire when they should.

  • Hands-on familiarity with how LLM systems actually work. You don't need production ML experience. But you need to have built something with these tools — an agent, a RAG pipeline, an internal tool — and to have used evals or experiments to decide whether it was any good. Tokens, context windows, prompt/response tracing, and why an eval suite is fundamental should all be familiar ground. Candidates who have only read about this are not a fit.

Nice to have

  • An LLM gateway or proxy (LiteLLM or similar) in production.

  • LLM observability tooling: Datadog LLM Observability, LangSmith, Braintrust, Arize, or similar.

  • Eval frameworks and LLM-as-judge scoring in a real workflow, not a demo.

  • FinOps instincts — cost attribution, showback, quota design.

  • Guardrails, PII detection, or content-filtering systems.

  • GCP alongside AWS.

AWS - GCP · EKS, Flux/GitOps, Karpenter · Python · LiteLLM · Datadog (LLM observability, APM) · Prometheus, Loki, ClickHouse · Terraform · GitLab CI

description:
ABOUT ORACLE CLOUD

Oracle Cloud is the first public cloud built from the ground up to be a better cloud for every application. By rethinking core engineering and systems design for cloud computing, we created innovations that solve problems that customers have with existing public clouds.

We accelerate migrations of existing enterprise workloads, deliver better reliability and performance for all applications, and offer the complete services customers need to build innovative cloud applications. There are six key reasons customers are choosing Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) for all their cloud workloads.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Oracle Cloud’s Government, Defence, and Intelligence team is a smart, motivated, and diverse group that is focused on bringing the world’s most important work to OCI. We build and operate our government, classified, and sovereign cloud regions to be reliable and high-performance, just like our public cloud. Our customers and their mission are the center of what we do. We strive to improve our knowledge of the challenges our customers face which we use to enhance our cloud capabilities and work together to deliver their mission.

JOB DESCRIPTION

We're looking for a Senior Technical Operations Engineer responsible for the operation of production environments, including systems and databases, supporting critical business operations. You will perform administration and analysis for multiple production environments and recommend new and novel solutions to improve availability, performance, and supportability.

This is an opportunity to bring a combination of deep technical knowledge with administration/analysis knowledge of Oracle's Cloud Infrastructure to provide escalation support to a wide range of complex production environment problems related to immense growth, scaling, leveraging the cloud, extremely high performance, and high availability requirements. As a Senior Technical Operations Engineer, you will also guide junior engineers to solve complex problems, take part in large-scale incident bridges and help to build new processes and procedures.

OCI IN <LOCATION>

As cloud investment in Northern Ireland continues to grow, companies and governments are moving more mission critical workloads to cloud, and Oracle is ensuring full support to our customers with our offerings. Oracle Cloud Isolated Regions (OCIR) are secure, air-gapped Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) solutions designed to meet the higher demands of global customers’ mission-critical classified workloads. These regions provide all OCI public cloud services (IaaS/PaaS/SaaS) in a physical location of the customer's choosing, supported and operated by dedicated personnel.

title: Technical Product Manager - Global Merchant Database
description:
Hello. We’re Teya.

Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.

They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving. Yet for too long, financial services has made life harder for them - with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business.

Teya exists to change that.

We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe - one built around simple tools, thoughtful design and real human support. Our Members rely on us to help them run their business with confidence, and that responsibility shapes the way we work.

We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand.

If you want to build meaningful products, solve real problems and make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you

Your Mission

As a Senior Product Manager in the Global Merchant Database team, your mission is to own and evolve a core platform that sits at the heart of the company’s ecosystem. You will lead the development of products that manage merchant data, product catalogues, pricing models, and agreements - enabling teams across the business to build reliable, scalable, and secure merchant-facing experiences.This is a platform and technical product role, working with a highly cross-functional set of internal stakeholders. You will act as the product owner for APIs, event-driven systems, and authorization models that underpin how merchant data is accessed and used across the company.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the product vision, roadmap, and delivery for key platform capabilities within the Global Merchant Database

  • Act as the product owner for merchant data APIs and event interfaces, treating APIs as first-class products

  • Work closely with engineering to define clear, scalable API contracts, event schemas, and data models

  • Ensure backward compatibility, versioning, and deprecation strategies are thoughtfully planned and communicated

  • Partner with internal teams to understand their needs and translate them into platform capabilities, not one-off solutions

  • Define and evolve authorization and access control models for merchant data, balancing security, compliance, and usability

  • Collaborate with design, engineering, marketing, operations, security, and legal teams to bring solutions to life

  • Translate complex technical and business requirements into clear, actionable product requirements

  • Prioritise ruthlessly based on platform impact, adoption, and long-term scalability

  • Define platform success metrics (e.g. adoption, reliability, performance, time-to-integrate) and continuously optimise post-launch

  • Support the coordination and integration of multiple new products each year, ensuring a reliable, intelligent merchant data foundation

  • Champion documentation excellence, including API documentation, changelogs, migration guides, and internal product RFCs

  • Act as a strong internal advocate for platform thinking, consistency, and simplicity

Required Skills & Experience

  • 5+ Years in a Product Manager Role

  • Solid understanding of how REST APIs work (and awareness of other integration patterns)

  • Hands-on experience testing APIs using tools such as Postman or similar

  • Experience working with event-driven systems and defining product-level event semantics

  • Ability to reason about system design trade-offs (sync vs async, scalability, reliability) from a product perspective

  • Understanding of data modeling, data types, and schema evolution

  • Basic SQL knowledge and comfort working with data directly

  • Familiarity with DDD concepts from a product perspective (domains, bounded contexts, ownership)

  • Experience defining authorization and access control models (e.g. roles, scopes, policies) in multi-tenant systems

The Perks

  • Flexible working hours, built on trust and collaboration with your team

  • Physical and mental health support through Wellhub, including access to 1,500+ gyms, 1-1 therapy, meditation, and wellbeing apps

  • Enhanced maternity and paternity leave options

  • Cycle-to-Work Scheme

  • Health and Life Insurance

  • Pension Scheme

  • 25 days of Annual Leave (+ Bank Holidays)

  • Office snacks every day

  • Friendly, comfortable, and informal office environment in Central London

title: Graduate Engineer Trainee
description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

Rockwell Automation's Safety, Sensing and Industrial Component Business is looking for a Graduate Engineer Trainee to be a significant contributor to the next generation new product development. You will have the opportunity to design and develop industry-leading commercial software, known for its innovation and usability. You will be highly involved in subsystem design, implementation, and testing, working very closely with the support of our senior engineers. You will play an active role in all the stages of the development lifecycle and support your team throughout the process. You will also help ensure that developed products meet requirements and are within total quality management standards. You will collaborate with multiple global cross-functional teams.

You will report to the Manager, Software Engineering and have a hybrid schedule working in Pune, India.

Your Responsibilities:

  • Develop system designs by understanding and following the software system requirements.

  • Establish a timeline for the design to track and report the progress. Consider tradeoffs between requirements, speed, cost, and reliability in the choice of a design approach.

  • Develop and documents code that meets the requirements of the software design.

  • Develop and execute unit test plans. Report, debugs, and corrects anomalies. Take the lead in the integration of other components to produce a final product.

  • Participate in reviews of documents, designs, code, test cases and user documentation.

  • Utilize automated test tools and methods to ensure full functional coverage is attained.

  • Perform routine product testing utilizing existing test collateral and test cases. Report any issues identified and documenting test results for follow-up.

The Essentials - You Will Have:

  • Bachelors in Computers Science/Information Technology.

  • Experience with basic software applications and technology.

The Preferred - You Might Also Have:

  • Build relationships and interact with peers to ensure assigned tasks are prioritized appropriately.

  • Actively seek knowledge of new developments in the software engineering, computer engineering, and software testing fields.

  • Identify software development capability improvements in software development practices, development tools, and test automation. May present ideas to the team for consideration.

  • Think outside the box and be willing to research and explore new avenues by using the latest technologies and standards.

What We Offer:

Our benefits package includes …

  • Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm

  • Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees

  • Company volunteer and donation matching program – Your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity can be matched with a charitable donation.

  • Employee Assistance Program

  • Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program

  • On-demand digital course library for professional development

... and other local benefits!

At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles.

#LI-JT1

Rockwell Automation’s hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.

  • Introductory interview with HR
  • Interviews with future colleagues of the engineering department
  • Final selection interview with HR
  • Contract proposal
